srhn.review: SRHN is a good faculty. Really easy slides and teaches well. Keeps the classes interesting and considers late entrance in morning classes by taking manual attendance. Takes viva but it's just a small qna session. Uploads the slides after the lecture of its topics. Questions are straightforward and easy to answer if you understand the concept and revise a bit before the exam. Really strict about exam hall conduct and cheating. Might make you do experimental stuff (We did acting in a class) which is a bit awkward if you're socially anxious. A/A- is very much attainable if you attend the classes and study properly before exam, notes aren't even needed.
